Quick HSK 1 quiz 🎂

生日 (shēngrì) is made of 生 = to be born and 日 = day. So what is a "born day"?

A) a birthday
B) a Sunday
C) a holiday

Comment A, B or C 👇 Bonus: how would you say "Happy birthday!" in Chinese? Hint: 快乐 (kuàilè) = happy.

📤 Send this to someone preparing for the HSK
